posts.author: Rosini
posts.content_md:
Good day,

I read of you on the web.

I need an hologram, it should be a circle of 25 mm diameter into which,

looking, you can see an image in 3 D.

The image will be an object in 3D, it will have to be as if it was

at 4 - 5 cm. from the surface of the hologram. Inside. As in a hole.

But I don' t need a box behind the hologram surface. It should be simply a

circular disk.

I heard about edge lit holograms.

What do you think?

Is it possible?

Could you help me?

Thank you!

Rosini

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
I don't think you want an edge lit hologram. For a disk, an edge lit hologram can be a little tricky. Can it simply be a reflection hologram in which the illuminated light source is over the viewer shoulder? An image that is located 5cm behind the disk of size 2.5cm is very doable. In fact if I am understanding you correctly, it seems what you want is sort of a watch crystal hologram like this.

[http://yodafans.homestead.com/files/Neo ... swatch.jpg](http://yodafans.homestead.com/files/NeoClassic/3dartswatch.jpg)

Or glasses crystal like this (scoll to holographam glasses)

[http://www.themagicstation.com/JokesNovel.html](http://www.themagicstation.com/JokesNovel.html)

 Is that correct?
